observations: Two-door wardrobe with a dark grey or black finish.
Left side contains four shelf compartments.
Right side features a larger compartment and a single drawer at the bottom.
Gold-toned T-bar handles on the door and drawer.
The unit is standing outdoors on unpaved, dusty ground.
Interior surfaces appear to be a lighter grey or lavender color.

Mechanical reliability of hinges and drawer runners requires physical testing or video.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bottom edges and underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having water damage/swelling at the base.

risks.risk: Structural instability or loose back panel.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the wardrobe.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a flimsy or detached back panel.

risks.risk: Misaligned doors or sticking drawer runners.
risks.proof: Video showing the drawer opening and doors closing flush.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the base and corners to check for chips or water damage.
Video of the drawer and doors in operation.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a standard 2-door wardrobe. Although the outdoor storage suggests potential condition issues, it can be priced at a worst-case 'fair' condition for this type of furniture.
